title: Easy-DHPSF open-source software for three-dimensional localization of single molecules with precision beyond the optical diffraction limit
protocol: Acquire raw data, calibration, and dark offset images.
Generate a .dat sequence log file.
Add the folder containing all Easy-DHPSF .m files to the MATLAB path.
Set the current folder to the folder containing your data.
Run easy_dhpsf.m to initialize the GUI.
Set the conversion gain in the main window.
Set the pixel size of the detector in object/sample space using the fields at the top of the main window.
Click the ‘run’ button in the ‘Calibrate DHPSF’ panel.
Set the EM gain used during acquisition of calibration images.
Open the calibration images file.
Open the dark offset image file matching the calibration.
Open the sequence log file for the calibration.
Select a region of interest containing at least one bright fluorescent object by adjusting the box and double-clicking inside it.
Click in the center of each DH-PSF to select fluorescent objects.
Inspect the angle vs. z position curve generated from calibration information to ensure linearity.
Check that the variation of angle measurements is not unreasonably high.
Select the most reliable calibration bead using the drop-down menu in the Easy-DHPSF main window.
Use the calibration information and templates from the selected bead for all later processing steps.
Click the ‘run’ button in the ‘Calibrate SM identification’ panel.
Set the EM gain and select the templates to be used.
Select a region containing the single molecules of interest.
Open the 'threshold [DateAndTime]' folder after template-matching is complete.
Identify potential template matches from .png files in the threshold folder.
Choose appropriate thresholds for each template to ensure faint visibility of DH-PSF lobes.
Enter selected thresholds into the ‘threshold’ field in the GUI.
Ensure a low rate of false matches for higher correlation values.
Click the 'run' button in the 'Track fiduciaries' panel.
Select a region of interest containing at least one bright fiducial by adjusting the box and double-clicking inside it.
Select one or more fiducials by clicking in the center of each DH-PSF.
After fitting the fiducials, select whether or not to apply the averaged correction to the output data by clicking the 'use fiducials' checkbox.
Click the 'run' button in the 'Localize DHPSF SMs' panel.
Choose the frames from the raw data to process.
Monitor the process whenever starting a new experiment to ensure that the threshold used includes single molecules visible in the raw data.
Ensure that the fits are performed successfully and only matches scoring above the thresholds are fit.
Plot good fits in the frame-by-frame reconstruction.
Define a good double-Gaussian fit as one meeting criteria hard-coded into the module.
